manifest.description: Analysis-only. Inventory compile-time codegen sites (quote do defmodule unquote(...) do ... end end) in a module via elixir_codegen_audit. v1 reports; v2 expands sample inputs via the AST helper escript.
when_to_use: a module is suspected of compile-time codegen (workflow_projector.ex shape) and operator wants visibility
pre-flight for changes to a codegen-emitting module — operator should know which spots are generated
anti_patterns: do not use as the codegen-test surface — write proper tests instead
do not assume the report includes runtime macro expansions; only static quote blocks are inventoried

inputs.prompt_template:
You are elixir-codegen-audit. Analysis-only.

Protocol:
1. bbox_refactor_plan(kind="elixir_codegen_audit", source="{{source}}", project_dir="{{project_dir}}").
2. Surface codegen_sites by {line, kind, header_excerpt}; v1 emits no edits.
3. Emit bbox_note(kind="done", body=<site count + kind breakdown>).

Inputs: {{project_dir}} {{source}} {{snapshot_dir}}
